source(output(
		BatchID as integer,
		GroupID as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		ClassID as string,
		Term_Date as string,
		Payment_due_amount as integer,
		FamilyID as string,
		Deliquent_date as string,
		Grace_Period as integer,
		Transaction_Code as string,
		Reinstatment_Reason_Code as string,
		Filler1 as string,
		Filler2 as string,
		Filler3 as string,
		CreateDateTime as timestamp,
		ReceiptAmt as integer,
		Due_Date as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT BatchID       ,[GroupID]       ,[SubscriberID]       ,[ClassID]       ,[Term_Date]       ,[Payment_due_amount]       ,[FamilyID]       ,[Deliquent_date]       ,Grace_Period       ,[Transaction_Code]       ,[Reinstatment_Reason_Code]       ,[Filler1]       ,[Filler2]       ,[Filler3]       ,[CreateDateTime]       ,[ReceiptAmt]       ,[Due_Date]   FROM [AutoTerm].[Delinquent_Reinstatement] WHERE SubscriberID IS NOT NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSourceAUTOTERMDELINQNTREINSTMNT
OLEDBSourceAUTOTERMDELINQNTREINSTMNT derive({Copy of SubscriberID} = SubscriberID,
		{Copy of Due_Date} = toString(Due_Date),
		{Copy of Reinstatment_Reason_Code} = Reinstatment_Reason_Code,
		{Copy of FamilyID} = FamilyID,
		{Copy of Term_Date} = Term_Date,
		{Copy of Transaction_Code} = Transaction_Code,
		{Copy of CreateDateTime} = toString(CreateDateTime),
		{Copy of Filler3} = Filler3,
		{Copy of Filler2} = Filler2,
		{Copy of Payment_due_amount} = Payment_due_amount,
		{Copy of Filler1} = Filler1,
		{Copy of BatchID} = BatchID,
		{Copy of Deliquent_date} = Deliquent_date,
		{Copy of ClassID} = ClassID,
		{Copy of ReceiptAmt} = ReceiptAmt,
		{Copy of GroupID} = GroupID,
		{Copy of Grace_Period} = Grace_Period) ~> DCAUTOTERMDELINQNTREINSTMNT
DCAUTOTERMDELINQNTREINSTMNT sink(input(
		{Copy of BatchID} as integer,
		{Copy of GroupID} as string,
		{Copy of SubscriberID} as string,
		{Copy of ClassID} as string,
		{Copy of Term_Date} as string,
		{Copy of Payment_due_amount} as integer,
		{Copy of FamilyID} as string,
		{Copy of Deliquent_date} as string,
		{Copy of Grace_Period} as integer,
		{Copy of Transaction_Code} as string,
		{Copy of Reinstatment_Reason_Code} as string,
		{Copy of Filler1} as string,
		{Copy of Filler2} as string,
		{Copy of Filler3} as string,
		{Copy of CreateDateTime} as string,
		{Copy of ReceiptAmt} as integer,
		{Copy of Due_Date} as string,
		Filler1 as string,
		Due_Date as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Filler3 as string,
		BatchID as integer,
		Filler2 as string,
		Payment_due_amount as integer,
		CreateDateTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ClassID as string,
		Transaction_Code as string,
		ReceiptAmt as integer,
		Term_Date as string,
		GroupID as string,
		Deliquent_date as string,
		Reinstatment_Reason_Code as string,

	),
